name: Thanksgiving & Christmas Whipped Sweet Potato Casserole with Toasted Marshmallows (No Pecans)
whyItWorks: Peeled, mashed sweet potatoes are packed with prebiotic soluble fiber and beta-carotene, and gelatin-based marshmallows melt into a zero-fiber sweet crust.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always choose the Marshmallow-topped half of the casserole (or bake yours with marshmallows and brown sugar only)—strictly avoiding any chopped pecan streusel topping.
watchOuts: Strictly avoid chopped pecan toppings on sweet potato casserole
